findings.detail: persistence never beats the zero-effect predictor (best +0.0000); it has no measurable causal understanding in this world.
ar never beats the zero-effect predictor (best +0.0000); it has no measurable causal understanding in this world.
gbdt never beats the zero-effect predictor (best -0.3084); it has no measurable causal understanding in this world.
wm_jepa never beats the zero-effect predictor (best -0.0139); it has no measurable causal understanding in this world.
True-simulator planning beats do-nothing by +0.189 return, so accurate dynamics are worth something here.

checks.detail: best world model (wm_rssm, +0.1438) beats the observation-space control with the identical multi-step objective (obsspace, -0.0306) on counterfactual skill
best world model (wm_graph, +0.0570) beats the Transformer baseline (-0.0425) at the deepest horizon
planning does not beat one-step greedy (-0.0099 return, p=0.627)
wm_plan beats llm by +0.1665 return (p=0.028, n=20)
unified does not beat wm_plan (-0.0785 return, p=0.222)
unified leads llm by +0.0880 but not distinguishably (p=0.076, n=20)
planning with the true simulator beats do-nothing by +0.1892 return, so accurate dynamics are worth something in this world
the true-simulator planner beats the learned planner by +0.2436 return (p=0.000); this is the headroom a better learned model could recover
